product_name.title: Product Name
product_name.description: The exact product name / title. Product truth; never invent claims not present here.

product_brand.title: Product Brand
product_brand.description: Optional brand name for the product.

product_category.title: Product Category
product_category.description: Detected product category (e.g. cosmetics, household_product). Drives realistic product handling physics.

product_facts.title: Product Facts
product_facts.description: Canonical product facts / description used to keep motion product-true. Do not add prices, ratings, sold counts, certifications, or efficacy claims that are not stated here.

shot_title.title: Shot Title
shot_title.description: The planner's title for this shot.

shot_visual.title: Shot Visual
shot_visual.description: The planner's staged composition for this shot.

shot_movement.title: Shot Movement
shot_movement.description: The planner's planned camera/subject motion for this shot. Primary basis for the motion prompt.

voiceover_excerpt.title: Voiceover Excerpt
voiceover_excerpt.description: This shot's voiceover line. Use only for emotional/narrative meaning; never render spoken words as visible text.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Target video aspect ratio (e.g. 9:16). Keep the product and speaking face inside safe framing.

duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds
duration_seconds.description: Length of this shot in seconds. Motion must complete within this duration.

shot_order.title: Shot Order
shot_order.description: 1-based position of this shot in the running order. Used to map the correct slice of a multi-shot user motion direction.

shot_count.title: Shot Count
shot_count.description: Total number of shots in the running order.

is_last_shot.title: Is Last Shot
is_last_shot.description: True when this is the final shot; honor the user's ending beat here.

start_frame_url.title: Start Frame URL
start_frame_url.description: URL of this shot's start keyframe image. The video must begin on this frame; ground all motion in it.

stop_frame_url.title: Stop Frame URL
stop_frame_url.description: Optional URL of this shot's stop keyframe image. When present, motion must end on this frame.

reference_product_images.title: Reference Product Images
reference_product_images.description: Product reference images (immutable product evidence). Never reshape, recolor, resize, or replace the product.

motion_direction.title: Motion Direction
motion_direction.description: Optional user free-text describing the desired product motion across the whole video. When present, treat as a MANDATORY ADDITIONAL directive and map only this shot's slice of the sequence.

voice_profile.title: Voice Profile
voice_profile.description: Optional deterministic descriptor of the single narrator voice used across every clip (e.g. 'one single consistent adult Thai female narrator voice'). Supplied only for native video-audio runs. When present, the prompt must state that this shot uses the same single narrator voice, timbre, tone, pacing, and language as every other clip.
